candidates.statement: REFERENCES • Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) • Public Health Service Act • 21 CFR 314.110, Complete response letter to the applicant DEFINITIONS • Resubmission : A submission to an NDA, BLA, or efficacy supplement that purports to answer the deficiencies that need to be addressed by the applicant before approval as set forth in the complete response letter.
